name: IDLES
description:
'''IDLES''' are a British [[post-punk]] band formed in [[Bristol]] in 2009. The band consists of Adam Devonshire (bass), [[Joe Talbot (singer)|Joe Talbot]] (vocals), Mark Bowen (guitar), Lee Kiernan (guitar), and Jon Beavis (drums).

After spending eight years honing their live performances, the band released their debut album, ''[[Brutalism (Idles album)|Brutalism]]'', in 2017 to critical acclaim. Their second album, ''[[Joy as an Act of Resistance]]'' (2018), increased their exposure significantly, and was followed by their first [[UK Albums Chart|UK number one]] album, ''[[Ultra Mono]]'', in 2020. 

The band released their fourth album, ''[[Crawler (album)|Crawler]]'', in 2021. ''[[Tangk]]'', their fifth studio album, was released in 2024 and became their second to reach number one in the UK. In 2025, the band provided the [[film score]] to [[Darren Aronofsky]]'s feature film, ''[[Caught Stealing (film)|Caught Stealing]]''.
